_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Archive profile UML. Source: metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfile/cdifArchiveDistribution/cdifArchiveDistributionSchema.json (cdifArchive merged in: archivePartArray/Item $defs now local to this BB). The Archive profile module documents how schema:hasPart describes component files inside an archive distribution (e.g. ZIP). It composes cdifCore (the host schema:Dataset + schema:DataDownload distribution shape); the archive-specific content is ArchiveDistribution (the host download, narrated as a sub-shape of CDIFCore::DataDownload in its definition text) and the ArchivePart items inside it (typed as schema:MediaObject). No direct DDI-CDI source classes apply, so every targetClass is mappingType=new. @id is modeled as the 'identifier' attribute per the cdifCore convention; @type is implied by the UML class name and is not modeled as an attribute. Generalization is documented narratively because the parent (DataDownload) lives in CDIFCore, not in this config.

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Archive Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Archive-distribution structure: a DataDownload that bundles component files (schema:hasPart -> schema:MediaObject)
targetModel.definition: CDIF Archive profile module - documents the archive-distribution pattern: a schema:DataDownload whose schema:hasPart enumerates component files (schema:MediaObject items) inside the archive (e.g. ZIP). Each ArchivePart records filename, MIME type(s), size, optional spdx:checksum, optional schema:about back-reference, and may carry data-description extensions (cdifTabularData, cdifDataCube). The composite cdifComplete profile pulls this module in. Conforms-to identifier: https://w3id.org/cdif/manifest/1.0.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Archive distribution structure: bundling component files inside a single download.

package.name: DataTypes
package.definition: Supporting value-object datatypes: QuantitativeValue (file size), Checksum (spdx).

class._comment: ArchiveDistribution - a schema:DataDownload that bundles multiple component files via schema:hasPart. Conceptually a sub-shape of CDIFCore::DataDownload (which carries the contentUrl/contentSize/encodingFormat attributes); CDIF adds only the schema:hasPart -> ArchivePart[] association. Modeled here as a standalone class because UML single-inheritance across profile configs is not directly expressed in the same config file; cross-profile reference is provided via the cross-profile registry.
class.definition: A schema:DataDownload distribution that is an archive file (e.g. ZIP, TAR) containing multiple component files described by schema:hasPart. The archive itself is independently accessible (contentUrl); its component files are NOT independently accessible and are typed as schema:MediaObject (not DataDownload). Inherits the standard DataDownload attributes (name, description, contentUrl, contentSize, encodingFormat, conformsTo) from CDIFCore::DataDownload (see that page); this UML restates only the archive-specific surface area.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for the archive distribution itself.

class._comment: ArchivePart - a single component file inside an archive distribution. Typed schema:MediaObject (not DataDownload, since these files are not independently fetchable). Required attributes per the JSON schema: @type (implicit), schema:name, schema:encodingFormat. Optional: description, size (QuantitativeValue), about (back-reference to a data file when this part is a metadata sidecar), spdx:checksum. May also carry CDIF data-description extensions (cdifTabularData, cdifDataCube) when the part is a tabular or cube data file inside the archive.
class.definition: A component file within an archive distribution. Typed as schema:MediaObject; carries filename, MIME type(s), optional size and checksum, and optional schema:about back-references when the part is a sidecar metadata file.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - identifier for this part, typically a hash-anchor (e.g. '#abc123'). Used as the target of schema:about back-references from sidecar metadata files inside the same archive.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - filename of the component file within the archive.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - short description of the file content.

attribute.name: encodingFormat
attribute.definition: schema:encodingFormat - MIME type(s) of this file.

class._comment: QuantitativeValue - inline value-object for schema:size on an ArchivePart. Generic numeric value with unit text. isDataType:true because identity is borne by the ArchivePart, not by this nested object.
class.definition: schema:QuantitativeValue - a numeric value with a unit, used here for schema:size on an ArchivePart. The value and unit are recorded inline; there is no independent identity.

attribute.name: unitText
attribute.definition: schema:unitText - unit of measure for the size (e.g. 'byte').

class._comment: Checksum - inline value-object on an ArchivePart for integrity verification. Uses SPDX vocabulary (spdx:Checksum / spdx:algorithm / spdx:checksumValue). isDataType:true (no independent identity).
class.definition: spdx:Checksum - inline checksum payload on an ArchivePart for integrity verification. Records the algorithm name and the digest value.

attribute.name: checksumValue
attribute.definition: spdx:checksumValue - the digest value as a hex string.

association._comment: ArchiveDistribution -> ArchivePart via schema:hasPart. Composition: the parts have no independent existence outside the archive distribution.
association.definition: schema:hasPart - the component files inside this archive distribution.

association._comment: ArchivePart -> ArchivePart via schema:about. A sidecar metadata file inside the archive can reference (via @id) another data file inside the same archive that it describes.
association.definition: schema:about - when this ArchivePart is a metadata sidecar, references the data ArchivePart this sidecar describes (typically via @id).

association._comment: ArchivePart -> Checksum via spdx:checksum. Composition: the Checksum value object has no independent identity.
association.definition: spdx:checksum - integrity-verification digest for this component file.
schema:size - file size as a QuantitativeValue (value + unitText).
